tasks.title: Add empty-string and unicode tests to tests/slug.test.mjs
tasks.intent: Extend tests/slug.test.mjs (existing simple test untouched) with: slug("") === "" (the pipeline is a no-op on empty input and the hyphen trim leaves ""), slug("Café") === "cafe" (NFKD decomposition plus \p{Diacritic} stripping), and slug("日本語") === "" (non-ASCII collapses to one hyphen that the final trim removes). The literal call slug("") must appear in the file to satisfy the TST-001-A grep acceptance. lib/slug.mjs is deliberately not a write target so TST-C01 cannot be violated.

tasks.title: Run suite and grep acceptance
tasks.intent: Execute TST-001-A (grep -rq 'slug("")' tests, exit 0) and TST-C01-A (node --test "tests/*.test.mjs", exit 0) to give both must properties an executed verification path against the unmodified lib/.

observations.statement: tests/slug.test.mjs currently covers only slug("Hello World"); lib/slug.mjs normalizes NFKD, strips combining diacritics, lowercases, replaces non-[a-z0-9] runs with "-", and trims leading/trailing hyphens.
TST-001-A is a grep for the literal slug("") call in tests, so the new tests must use double-quoted empty-string argument syntax verbatim.
